scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm checking on the status. Could you tell me if my application has been approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: Your application has been approved and the loan has been originated. Is there anything else you would like to know about your loan?

dialogue.user: Great! Could you tell me the interest rate and the total costs associated with this loan? Also, is there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate is exempt, and the total loan costs are also exempt. Additionally, this is not a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and there is no negative amortization feature. Is there anything else you would like to know?

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? And what does my debt-to-income ratio mean for my application?
dialogue.agent: The loan has not been sold to another institution. The debt-to-income ratio is exempt. Is there anything else you would like to know about your loan?

dialogue.user:
That covers everything I needed to know. Thank you for your help!

<Very Satisfied> - The agent was very helpful and provided all the information I needed in a clear and professional manner.
